import csv, statistics
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('capture/presentmon.csv')))
mbp=[float(r['MsBetweenPresents']) for r in rows]
t=[float(r['TimeInSeconds']) for r in rows]
api=[float(r['MsInPresentAPI']) for r in rows]
n=len(mbp)
# p99 linear interpolation
s=sorted(mbp); k=0.99*(n-1); f=int(k); p99=s[f]+(k-f)*(s[f+1]-s[f])
print('p99',round(p99,3),'low',round(1000/p99,2),'avg',round(1000/statistics.mean(mbp),2))
# hitch frames correlation with sensor L1 seconds
l1={2,6,10,14,18,22,26,30,34,38,42,46,50,54,58}
bad=[i for i in range(n) if mbp[i]>15]
inl1=sum(1 for i in bad if int(t[i]) in l1)
print('bad frames',len(bad),'in L1 seconds',inl1)
print('mean MsInPresentAPI during hitches',round(statistics.mean(api[i] for i in bad),2),'vs normal',round(statistics.mean(api[i] for i in range(n) if mbp[i]<10),2))
# predicted after fix: exclude L1 windows
keep=[mbp[i] for i in range(n) if not (int(t[i]) in l1 and t[i]%1>=0.3)]
ks=sorted(keep); kn=len(keep); kk=0.99*(kn-1); kf=int(kk); kp99=ks[kf]+(kk-kf)*(ks[kf+1]-ks[kf])
print('post-fix est avg',round(1000/statistics.mean(keep),1),'low',round(1000/kp99,1))
